scope: Retrospective development-only physical prescreen on historical vertex-count63 PMFs; no functional labels or full-sequence-space guarantee.
annotation_scope: Cached explicit GO:0003723 OR ribosomal protein name; no GO ancestor expansion, no functional-negative inference from missing annotation.

definitions.uncertain: lower<0.8<=upper, remains in ranking pool and budget
definitions.precision: certified target hit/K is not exact true physical precision; bounds include unknown selected labels.
definitions.recall_bounds: Min assign all unselected uncertain positive, selected uncertain negative; max reverse. These are conservative label-identification bounds, not statistical confidence intervals. Null only if denominator can be0.
definitions.cost: N-to-K counts only, not unmeasured wall-time savings; known unselected certified positives remain missed. Same historical target/cohort, not a new-C or universe guarantee.

uncertainty: Label-identification bounds, not confidence intervals; all uncertain labels remain in pool and selected budget.
independence: Seeds are repeated realizations on identical objects; T and group counts are distinct. No p averaging across measurement views.
